baslik: The Silent Gas That Kills You in Your Sleep
aciklama:
Carbon monoxide has no smell, no color, and kills people in their sleep. Here is how the silent killer works.

#shorts #science #safety #health #howitworks

sahneler.metin: This gas kills people in their sleep, with no warning.
Every year it kills hundreds of Americans at home.
Carbon monoxide has no color, no smell, not even a taste.
It comes from anything burning fuel: heaters, cars, stoves.
The reason: your blood grabs it over two hundred times more readily than oxygen.
So you suffocate in a room full of air.
A cheap detector is the only thing that can warn you.

vaka.ders: a cheap detector is the only warning
vaka.yanilgi: CO poisoning is often mistaken for flu or tiredness — which is exactly why it kills sleeping people.
vaka.tartisma: Should carbon monoxide detectors be mandatory in every home with a fuel-burning appliance?
